'''Seni Kilwallen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on [[G'rho]]. She was a member of the [[G'rho Defense Force]] and flew a [[Conjo fighter]]. She was married to fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Trig Kilwallen|Trig]].
